definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepayment; money paid upfront
definitions.explanation: Payment made before goods are delivered or services are rendered. The full amount or a portion paid in advance.

examples.japanese: {前金|まえきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{前金|まえきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I received half the amount as an advance payment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前金|まえきん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This shop operates on a prepayment system, requiring full payment at the time of order.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before, in advance) and {金|きん} (money). The opposite is {後金|あときん} (payment after delivery). Common in business transactions, rental agreements, and service contracts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前金|まえきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay in advance
- {前金|まえきん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: prepayment system
- {前金|まえきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as an advance payment
- {前金|まえきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive advance payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手付金|てつけきん}→手付金：29465_tetsukekin⟧: deposit, earnest money — specifically a partial payment that secures an agreement
- ⟦{頭金|あたまきん}→頭金：29480_atamakin⟧: down payment — the initial payment in an installment plan
- ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧: prepayment — similar meaning, slightly more general in usage
